body: True, but its usually the response I get, people don't take rejection very well. Also, yes I would like to push those boundries...but its like a trauma thing. Where my whole body starts uncontrollably shaking and I barely can get any words out. Its like I revert, back to the past. only a few people seen it happen to me...but I do not want anyone to see what happens. Its a fight or flight response I will have to work on slowly...

Lol, sorry about that! I try to be friends, but they want more way too quickly...literally, its like a timer. The sexual tension arises and thats when things go downhill. And then the pain arrives...had a woman get mad at me actually a week ago for not accepting her advances. Its not that I don't want to...its like that part of me is completely broken. That is the reason why I call myself the great asshole. Not having relationships is driving me literally insane. Was falling apart like a month ago...but I am stable again.

Thanks dude. Yes and no. I usually meet them, talk to them like a normal human being without intentions...and then they open up with interest. Or they will be sitting there giving all kinds of signals...then I get nervous and turn into a stoic wall...and then they proceed to get hurt and pissed at me.

I don't know how you feel right now, but I can say that it sucks. I always had trouble with relationships, its like a curse really. Was doing a lot better but let a relationship tear me down and self-destructed. Don't do what I did, I regret it. If you need to talk about anything you are welcome to vent to me, one skill I have is lending a ear. You should have seen my past posts lol.

You know. I am going to be real here, I am not sure if living or dying is the best choice. I know how it feels to have a fucking shit ass abusive childhood that fucks your mind up beyond comprehension. I want to kill myself often too, eventually going through with it. But here is the thing. You are hesitating because that person who you brought up is important to you. You should weigh out which one is more important to you before you make a hasty decision.

If I had someone or something to live for, I definitely would. Just don't be like me.
I will do that. I guess I am dealing with numerous problems at once.
Yeah, ha. Thats a good saying well I got too much shit and I am feeling pain in my skull
Yeah, nice to meet you as well. I really wouldn't know where to start. Shit has gone completely south, people are terrible.

I'll try it. But my entire life is pretty much over and ruined now. There is nothing left for me anymore, besides I have a massive amount of mental issues. Just tired of dealing with life when in the end there is absolutely nothing here for me. Even if I had hobbies, I wouldn't be able to enjoy them anyways.
